editorial.name: Oku
editorial.descriptionZh: 读书追踪 App 的官网：把在读、想读、读完的书排成书架，做阅读目标、自定义书单和阅读统计，还能看朋友的进度与社区书评。有网页版和 App Store 客户端。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把读书记录从表格搬到书架，再挂上阅读目标
editorial.noteZh: 首屏大半留白，左边三行衬线字 The companion app for every book，下面 Join for free 与 App Store 下载徽标，再一行小字 Already a member? Sign in.；右边一张黑白铅笔插画，一个卷发的人探身去够书架上的书。往下按 Track your reading and build your library（配一句 no spreadsheets needed）、Discover your new favorite book、Kickstart your reading habit、See your personalized reading stats、Create custom collections、Read community reviews and add your own 逐条排开。页面底部是一段实时动态流，写着 Trevor·5 hours ago Reading Dot Journaling—A Practical Guide、pet·7 hours ago Added to selling Amsterdam、noel·13 hours ago Wants to read More Everything Forever，读完后补一句 53% of our members have imported their historical data from Goodreads.。

reasons.statement: 交付的是 Oku 这个读书 App 的功能介绍、Join for free 与 App Store 下载入口，站内没有可复制的素材或代码，按产品官网归入单站展示。
